has_own_site_check: hausheadspa.com resuelve HTTP 200, es un sitio propio completo (Wix o similar) con la misma direccion exacta (10075 Yamato Road, Suite 1, Boca Raton, FL 33498) y telefono (+1 561-826-7435) que la ficha de Google Maps: confirmado que es el mismo negocio. NO estaba declarado en el brief original (que asumia 'sin website propio' basado solo en que la ficha de Maps apunta a Instagram). Se encontro durante research vía busqueda web. Angulo de outreach cambiado a 'propuesta de rediseño premium', nunca afirmar que no tienen sitio.

instagram.note: Confirmado activo y del negocio: enlazado desde hausheadspa.com y desde su ficha de Google Maps. Scraping directo de instagram.com (Playwright y curl) devolvio net::ERR_HTTP_RESPONSE_CODE_FAILURE / 429 en este entorno; bio no verificada por ese canal, pero no fue necesaria: hausheadspa.com ya dio booking, email, Facebook y galeria completos.

booking_source: Boton 'Book Now' de hausheadspa.com, verificado HTTP 200 directo.
hours: Tuesday to Sunday, 10 AM to 7 PM. Monday by appointment only (segun hausheadspa.com; la ficha de Google Maps muestra variantes horarias por feriado de Accion de Gracias/Black Friday en el momento del scrape, se prefirio el horario base publicado por el negocio).
services_source: Menu COMPLETO con precios reales extraido de hausheadspa.com (secciones Head Spa, Facials, Permanent Makeup, Lashes & Brows). El site usa solo la porcion de Head Spa (4 cards destacadas) y menciona el resto del menu en la nota/pie, consistente con el nicho principal del negocio.

reviews_verbatim.texto: The experience at this spa was, without a doubt, the most relaxing I've ever had. Leticia and Angela were absolutely amazing and took exceptional care of both my daughter and me from the moment we arrived. I booked this as part of my daughter's 21st birthday celebration, and it made the day even more special. Their professionalism, kindness, and attention to detail created an unforgettable experience. We left feeling completely relaxed and pampered, and we will definitely be back. Highly recommend!

Had such an amazing experience at Haus Head Spa! Leticia was absolutely incredible. She was so welcoming, attentive, and made the entire experience unbelievably relaxing from start to finish. The head spa treatment itself was amazing and my scalp and hair felt so refreshed afterward. You can tell Leticia genuinely cares about making sure you're comfortable and getting the most out of the experience. Definitely one of those treatments where you leave feeling completely reset. Highly recommend Haus Head Spa, and definitely ask for Leticia!

I went in for the head spa and had Irina do my service. She arrived before my appointment and we started on time. She was very knowledgeable and did an amazing job with the treatment, and made sure to offer drinks/snacks. It was very relaxing and my scalp looked and felt amazing afterwards!

We had such a wonderful experience. The atmosphere was so relaxing and welcoming, and the entire experience was incredibly enjoyable from start to finish. Everything was wonderful, and we left feeling refreshed and relaxed. Highly recommend if you're looking for a little self-care and pampering. We'll definitely be back!

If I could come here everyday I would!! Such an incredible experience! The spa is modern/clean/great atmosphere/aesthetic. I highly recommend Angela, she was fantastic and made the entire experience so relaxing! Book your appointment today, I promise you will not regret it!! (Haus Head spa please open a location in Westlake!)
